title: Exceptions and Explicit Result Modelling Quick Check

questions.prompt: Where should an exception normally be caught?
questions.answer: Where recovery or translation policy exists
questions.explanation: A catch is valuable when the layer knows how to respond meaningfully.
options: Where recovery or translation policy exists
Only in main regardless of context

questions.prompt: Catching Throwable is a safe default for user-facing recovery.
questions.explanation: Throwable includes failures and control signals that ordinary recovery should not swallow.

questions.prompt: Why return a sealed domain result for expected outcomes?
questions.answer: It exposes meaningful alternatives in the type and enables exhaustive handling
questions.explanation: Typed alternatives communicate product meaning more clearly than null or broad exceptions.
